row: Meridian ID Gonstead Spine & Wellness Chiropractic

Welcome to Meridian Idaho Gonstead Spine & Wellness—your home for precise, patient-centered chiropractic care led by Dr. Todd Pickman. Our clinic is the only healthcare facility in Idaho offering Digital Motion X-ray, giving us the ability to identify hidden spinal issues that traditional imaging often misses. We specialize in the Gonstead Chiropractic Technique, Chiropractic BioPhysics CBP, Chiropractic Spinal Decompression, weight-bearing digital X-rays, corrective care, & advanced spinal rehabilitation. Whether you’re dealing with neck pain, low back pain, sciatica, disc injuries, posture problems, or injuries from sports or car accidents, our goal is to locate the exact source of your problem and create a customized plan to help you heal. From detailed structural analysis to corrective exercises and ongoing wellness strategies, we help patients move better, feel stronger, and return to the activities they love. Discover a higher standard of chiropractic care right here in Meridian.
